description: Alpaka Addons is a client-side Fabric mod for Hypixel SkyBlock with slayer tracking, chat upgrades and visual tweaks.

mods.name: Alpaka Addons
mods.description: Client-side quality-of-life for Hypixel SkyBlock: slayer tracking, a better chat, movable HUDs and a cleaner look. Sends nothing on your behalf.

releases.notes:
**New**
- Ragnarock: cast countdown under the crosshair
- Boss Cocoon Alert when the slayer boss spawns in a cocoon
- Better Chat: Movable Chat, Better Scrollbar, Opening Animation
- Chat stays above the whole HUD with Better Chat
- Hide Fire Overlay, Hide Mob Fire, Disable Fire Animation
- Old Master Stars
- Cache Resource Pack
- AlpakaAddons Scoreboard Footer

**Changed**
- Better Chat main switch with a reworked chat blur
- Hide Slayer Chat Spam: each group can be toggled on its own
- Chat Tabs: Guild Chat Only In Guild Tab
- Smooth Chat Strength is shown in milliseconds
- Mod messages use a gradient [Alpaka] prefix instead of [AA]
- /alpakaslayer is shown as one block with a single [Alpaka] prefix
- Name Tags: Background Color, Text Shadow, Show Own Nametag
- Fire Pit Highlight: Fire Pit Color
- Inventory Snowflakes: Snowflake Amount slider
- Inventory HUD: one Visibility choice instead of two toggles
- Command wheel: bigger page arrows, one page per gesture
- Right click a HUD in the HUD Editor to open its settings
- HUD Editor button in the sidebar's bottom corner
- Scoreboard and Screenshots have their own config sections
- Main menu rows tint their icon on hover
- Slayer personal bests are kept per tier
- Offer Replies To !since removed
- Pangolin Highlight removed

**Fixed**
- World age shows the right day on the Private Island and where Hypixel freezes the clock
- Main menu Hypixel status no longer shows offline when the server is up
- Main menu status dot is centered and each row has only one hover background
- Slayer personal bests only count fully watched fights
- Bosses hatched from a cocoon can set a personal best
- Damage tags recognize Ring of Love splashes with a heart
- No line hover highlight while peeking the chat
- Command wheel labels no longer overlap

- Screenshots renamed to Better Screenshots

- Reset button in every color picker

mods.name: Alpaka Addons
mods.description: Client-side quality-of-life for Hypixel SkyBlock: slayer tracking, a better chat, movable HUDs and a cleaner look. Sends nothing on your behalf.

releases.notes:
**New**
- Clean Blaze Parts – pick what Clean Blaze hides: particles (flame, smoke, angry villager, lava drip), burning, fireballs, lightning (bolt and sky flash) and name tags
- Clean Blaze also takes the burning off the Blaze minibosses (Flare, Kindleheart, Burningsoul Demon), the boss and its demons
- Co-op chat tab
- Offer Replies To !since – a button that fills in the reply in your chat box, never sends it for you (off by default)
- Share Buttons On Top Drops – a button that fills in a drop announcement in your chat box (off by default)
- `/alpakaslayer since <item>` – shows locally how many bosses since that drop
- `/alpakadebug perf` – shows how much time the mod's features take
- Vampire slayer XP is tracked

**Changed**
- The mod no longer sends chat for you: the automatic `!since` party reply and the guild drop announcement are gone, replaced by the opt-in buttons above
- Clean Blaze only works on SkyBlock in the Blaze slayer zones (Stronghold, The Wasteland, Smoldering Tomb), so flames, torches and fire elsewhere stay visible – including the Magma Boss's flame rings
- Clean Blaze leaves name tags visible by default, so you can still see the blazes' health, and your own fire always stays visible
- Colour and "open" options in the config react to a click anywhere on their card, like toggles. Loading and saving presets still needs the button
- Destructive actions in the config ask for confirmation, and some commands need you to type a confirmation
- Chat tabs sort messages by what the line looks like, so public chat mentioning "party" or "guild" stays in All. The mod's own messages now only show in All
- Slayer boss times are measured from the boss appearing to its death, like SkyHanni. Times where the start wasn't seen are shown as unverified and never count as a personal best
- Pangolin highlight only shows when you can actually see the pangolin; player scale is limited to a sensible range
- "Network Features" is now "Allow Network Features"; the main menu's Hypixel ping runs in the background
- Colour picker, command wheel editor and main menu fit small windows
- After an update a one-time chat line links the release notes

**Fixed**
- Chat could spill out of its box while smooth scrolling (the chat clip never loaded)
- Crash on a clean install without Fabric Language Kotlin – it is now a required dependency
- A broken or empty config no longer crashes the game or resets everything; it is restored from the backup with a notice
- Slayer stats no longer lose kills when you play on several accounts or profiles, and older stats are no longer imported twice
- Changing worlds or servers mid-fight no longer counts a phantom slayer kill; cancelled quests are counted correctly
- Bosses whose grinding phase was too short to see (e.g. right after a cocooned boss) are no longer marked unverified
- A fifth notification no longer freezes the game
- Resizing the main menu no longer breaks its blur
- Smooth Perspective no longer makes blocks and entities vanish at the edge of the screen
- The viewmodel offset is no longer applied twice, and the swing animation plays on the arm that actually swings
- Custom sounds and muted sounds are handled more reliably
- The inventory HUD attached to the hotbar no longer covers the hearts, armour or action bar
- HUD elements no longer overlap at their default positions
- Name tag text draws over its background
- Typing an F in the config search, a hex colour or the command wheel editor no longer opens chat peek
- Screenshot messages: the Copy button is hidden on macOS, and deleting a screenshot needs two clicks
- Unused textures, sounds, fonts and a resource pack were removed, making the jar smaller

**New**
- Chat Search – Ctrl+F in the chat filters it to messages containing your text
- Smooth Chat – new messages slide in, scrolling glides, and an optional blurred, rounded chat background
- Chat Peek In Menus – Peek Chat also works while an inventory or other menu is open
- Tab cycles the chat tabs (Shift+Tab backwards), and the tabs also show while peeking
- Wide Health Bar – both heart rows joined into one long row in place of the hunger and armor bars
- Scrollable Tooltips – the mouse wheel scrolls tooltips taller than the screen
- Keep Item Name Visible – the held item's name above the hotbar no longer fades out
- Party Invite Prompt – a party invite shows up as a notification, Y accepts and N dismisses
- Swing Motion Blur for the held item, with length, opacity and step settings
- Always Sprint
- Menu Font option for the Alpaka menus (Inter by default, also Poppins, Outfit, Varela Round or the Minecraft font)
- `/alpakapreset save <1|2|3>` – saves the current viewmodel settings to a preset slot
- Notifications: time-left bar and a new Top Center position
- Inventory HUD flat style: blurred background and a gradient frame with its own colours
- Player model HUD: toggle for its name tag

**Changed**
- Minecraft 26.2 only – support for 26.1.2 is paused for now
- Config, main menu and pause menu share one new style with rounded panels and a teal accent (Menu Accent Color on General)
- Config: sliding toggles, rounded controls, gliding tab highlight; on the Item Viewmodel tab a handle moves the panel aside so the held item stays in view
- Main menu: frosted glass tabs over the panorama and a Join Hypixel tab with the live player count and ping
- Pause menu: glass buttons on the blurred world in vanilla's layout, a shorter disconnect prompt, and Essential's side panels still show
- Notifications are a flat glass pane
- Compact Chat also stacks repeats with other messages in between – the Compact Chat Window slider sets how far back
- Quick Command Wheel: pages of up to twelve commands with edge arrows, settings screen with drag-and-drop ordering
- Inventory HUD only slides in when attached to the hotbar; the player model HUD appears instantly

**Fixed**
- Crash when opening the config in a small window
- Always Finish Swing: held attacks (mining, farming) no longer pause between swings
- SkyHanni's and Skyblocker's tab lists no longer open while Tab switches chat tabs
- Main menu glass tabs now also blur resource-pack menu backgrounds

**New**
- Chat Tabs – All, Party, Guild and PMs tabs above the chat input, with unread counts; optionally, messages typed on a channel tab go to that channel
- Chat Peek – hold a key (unbound by default, Options > Controls) to read and scroll the full chat while playing
- Compact Chat – a message repeated right after itself stacks into one line with (x2), (x3)…
- Better Screenshot Message – Open, Copy and Delete buttons on the screenshot notice, plus Auto Copy Screenshots
- Hide Mob Deaths – dying mobs vanish instead of tipping over
- Hide Damage Flash and a toggle for an unlit held item
- Etherwarp overlay that marks the landing block, with selectable warp sounds
- Player Scale per axis for your own model and, optionally, other players

**Changed**
- Expand Chat History also keeps the chat and the sent-message history when you leave a server and join again
- Samurai Hat is now the Sensei Hat, modelled as a real sugegasa – plain straw by default, chroma colours optional
- Block Overlay draws only the outer edges of stairs, cauldrons, fences and other multi-part blocks
- Inventory HUD chest style is drawn as a real small chest with an "Inventory" title
- Command wheel redesigned as a segmented dial with a pointing wedge; the aimed-at command takes the accent colour

**Fixed**
- Slayer stats no longer start from zero when the stats folder is not mounted yet (e.g. a cloud drive that syncs late)
